reviews.title: Unreliable privacy settings
reviews.text:
I rather have dead plants than to use this sus app. I deleted this app a few minutes after downloading and opening for the first time. First prompt was “allow location” which I promptly selected “Never.” Then I go to the “Account” tab on the app and clicked on “Location” where I assume I can enter in mg zip code. 

Lo and behold the app recognized my location already. Thought I was crazy so I went into the iPhone’s privacy settings and saw that Location services set as “Never” yet so curious how the app knew my city and zip code without user input???

reviews.title: Need more to be useful
reviews.text: I use this up for my second year. It has basic functions that are useful, but it is difficult to navigate and needs more features to help manage the garden.   For example, Plese have an easy way to find out where in my garden I planted a specific vegetable and what its status is.
